Consumer side (GeyserMC/Floodgate, HEAD 81b65ccb):

  core/.../config/... username-prefix "." and replace-spaces true (config.yml defaults)
  Utils.getJavaUuid: new UUID(0, xuid)

Facts encoded:
  * Marker: "^Floodgate^" + char(0x3E) = "^Floodgate^>"  (the ">" is 0x3E, not an HTML entity)
  * BedrockData: 12 NUL-separated fields in order: version, username, xuid,
    deviceOs, languageCode, uiProfile, inputMode, ip, linkedPlayer, fromProxy,
    subscribeId, verifyCode. Unlinked => literal "null". fromProxy => "0"/"1".
  * Wire: "^Floodgate^>" + b64(iv) + "!" + b64(ciphertext || 16-byte GCM tag)
  * Handshake host = hostname + "\0" + wire

Expected outputs (in the JSON):
  prefixed username ".Bedrock_User" (raw "Bedrock User"), XUID 2535400000000001,
  UUID 00000000-0000-0000-0009-01eed05d1001.

Not verified in this run (state these as open):
  * The exact Java call site applying the username prefix/space replacement
    (config keys confirmed; the code path was not line-verified).
  * The 255-char Minecraft Handshake server-address limit is taken from the
    protocol documentation (wiki.vg), not re-checked against a live client.
  * The Java sources were not compiled or executed. Independence rests on a
    Python re-implementation of the framing plus cryptography's hazmat GCM.
